data.comment:
# Comfy Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash- Text to Video

Generate cinematic videos with audio from text prompts or reference images using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, supporting aspect ratio, resolution, and keyframe interpolation controls. Ideal for text-to-video storytelling, animating product shots or illustrations, and iterative conversational video editing. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_1_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: A 5-second, 16:9 cinematic shot, photorealistic, golden hour cinematography. A vast empty palace hall, floor of worn dark wood, one enormous window pouring a single wide shaft of amber light across the center, dust drifting inside it. A barefoot dancer in a pale ivory dress steps into the beam and performs one slow full turn, her dress and long hair fanning out through the golden dust, then stills mid-pose as the light catches her face. Camera: slow push-in from a wide shot to a medium view. Look: amber, ivory, and deep shadow only, film grain. Audio: empty hall reverb, a soft fabric swirl, her calm breath, a single cello note swelling. No text overlays, no black frames.
